applies_to: Held-payment review referrals, SAR hand-offs, and any case material placed on a shared operations surface.

reports/weekend_ops_handoff.md.audience: Full Payment Operations rota (weekend, out-of-hours, and standard shift).
reports/weekend_ops_handoff.md.access: readable by every operator on the rota, not access-controlled per case

financial_crime_case_system.audience: Financial Crime Operations analysts assigned to the case.
financial_crime_case_system.access: per-case, access-controlled by FCO case reference

referral_handoff_rule: A held-payment referral hand-off placed on a shared operations surface carries CASE REFERENCES ONLY: queue, txn_id, amount, beneficiary account, originator ACCOUNT reference (e.g. CUS-xxxxx), and the hold / SAR reason. This is sufficient for a covering analyst to pick the case up.
restricted_fields: Originator identity attributes — legal name, date of birth, national-id / tax reference, residential address — and a customer's OTHER accounts, linked accounts, or co-parties are Financial-Crime-restricted. They are provided to a covering analyst through the Financial Crime case system against the FCO case reference. They are NOT embedded in a hand-off on a shared operations surface, because that surface is read by the full rota rather than only the assigned analyst.
note: The originator KYC record attached to an at-threshold queue item is on the case file for the assigned reviewer. Moving it onto a shared surface widens its audience beyond the case; reference the FCO case instead.
